fields.Name: RubricDriftPeriodMeans
fields.UserQuestion: How did each agent's rubric criterion mean change between the last two periods?
fields.Description: Mean normalized score per agent, rubric, and criterion for two time windows. Counts only Submitted evaluations that are not self-checks, and only the evaluator's own scores.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Groups RubricEvaluationScore by AI Agent name, Rubric name, and criterion Key. previousStart, currentStart, and periodEnd ({{ previousStart | sqlDate }}, {{ currentStart | sqlDate }}, {{ periodEnd | sqlDate }}) bound the two windows [previousStart, currentStart) and [currentStart, periodEnd). Status is Submitted and EvaluatorType is not Self.

fields.Name: currentStart
fields.Description: The start date of the current drift window.

fields.Name: periodEnd
fields.Description: The end date of the evaluation period.

fields.Name: previousStart
fields.Description: The start date of the previous drift window.

fields.Name: AgentName
fields.Description: The name of the AI agent.

fields.Name: RubricName
fields.Description: The name of the rubric used for evaluation.

fields.Name: CriterionKey
fields.Description: The key identifier of the rubric criterion.

fields.Name: CurrentMean
fields.Description: The average normalized score for the current drift window.
fields.ComputationDescription: AVG(CASE WHEN evaluation.[SubmittedAt] >= currentStart AND evaluation.[SubmittedAt] < periodEnd THEN score.[NormalizedScore] END)

fields.Name: PreviousMean
fields.Description: The average normalized score for the previous drift window.
fields.ComputationDescription: AVG(CASE WHEN evaluation.[SubmittedAt] >= previousStart AND evaluation.[SubmittedAt] < currentStart THEN score.[NormalizedScore] END)
